from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import datetime, gzip, hashlib, json, math

p = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
read = lambda name: json.loads((p / name).read_text())
seal, plan = read("seal.json"), read("plan.json")
report = read("screen/development/report.json")
assert report["seal"] == seal["sha256"] and len(report["rows"]) == 648
for source in seal["sources"]:
    assert hashlib.sha256((Path(seal["root"]) / source["path"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == source["sha256"], source["path"]
parent = json.loads(gzip.decompress((p / "parent-development-control-outcomes.json.gz").read_bytes()))
expected = {(row["caseId"], row["arm"]): row["execution"]["outcome"] for row in parent["outcomes"]}
cases = {case["id"]: case for case in plan["development"]}
rows = {(row["caseId"], row["arm"]): row for row in report["rows"]}
assert len(rows) == 648
assert set(rows) == {(c, arm) for c in cases for arm in ["current", "protect-entrant", "joint-entrant"]}
counts, same_parents, preview_checks = defaultdict(Counter), 0, 0
for key, row in rows.items():
    outcome = row["execution"]["outcome"]
    assert outcome["terminal"] and not outcome["qualityErrors"] and outcome["decisions"] > 0
    diagnostic = outcome["diagnostics"]
    assert diagnostic["leftSetupSpend"] <= diagnostic["leftSetupBudget"]
    assert diagnostic["rightSetupSpend"] <= diagnostic["rightSetupBudget"]
    assert diagnostic["previewRngUuidChecks"] == diagnostic["deliveryPreviewCalls"]
    occupied = set()
    for unit in outcome["evidence"]["opening"]["units"]:
        assert unit["placed"] and unit["amountAlive"] > 0
        for cell in unit["cells"]:
            cell_key = cell["x"], cell["y"]
            assert 0 <= cell_key[0] < 16 and 0 <= cell_key[1] < 16 and cell_key not in occupied
            occupied.add(cell_key)
    winners = [event["winningTeam"] for action in outcome["evidence"]["final"]["journal"]
               for event in json.loads(action["eventsJson"]) if event["type"] == "fight_finished"]
    assert winners and all(w == winners[-1] for w in winners) and winners[-1] in [0, 1, 2]
    team = cases[key[0]]["input"]["candidateTeam"]
    assert outcome["score"] == (0.5 if winners[-1] == 0 else int(winners[-1] == team))
    counts[key[1]][str(outcome["score"])] += 1
    if key in expected:
        assert outcome == expected[key], (key, "complete original parent control mismatch")
        same_parents += 1
    if key[1] == "joint-entrant":
        events = outcome["evidence"]["jointDeliveryPreviews"]
        assert len(events) > 1
        for event in events:
            assert event["team"] == team
            assert event["joint"] == event["contact"] + event["shooting"]["score"]
            assert sum(a["value"] for a in event["augments"]) == diagnostic["leftSetupBudget" if team == 2 else "rightSetupBudget"]
            total = 0
            for shooter in event["shooting"]["rows"]:
                assert len(shooter["divisors"]) == 12 and all(d in [1, 2, 4, 8] for d in shooter["divisors"])
                coverage = sum(1 / d for d in shooter["divisors"]) / 12
                assert coverage == shooter["coverage"]
                score = shooter["xpWeight"] * shooter["attack"] / shooter["printedAttack"] * coverage
                assert abs(score - shooter["score"]) <= 1e-10
                total += shooter["score"]
            assert abs(total - event["shooting"]["score"]) <= 1e-10
            preview_checks += 1
assert same_parents == 432

comparisons = []
for comparison in report["comparisons"]:
    family = defaultdict(list)
    changed = defaultdict(bool)
    gains = losses = 0
    for case_id, case in cases.items():
        a = rows[case_id, comparison["baseline"]]["execution"]["outcome"]
        b = rows[case_id, comparison["candidate"]]["execution"]["outcome"]
        q = round(2 * (b["score"] - a["score"]))
        family[case["family"]].append(q)
        changed[case["family"]] |= a["digest"] != b["digest"]
        gains += q > 0
        losses += q < 0
    names = sorted(family)
    quarters = [sum(family[name]) for name in names]
    assert len(names) == 108 and all(len(v) == 2 for v in family.values())
    assert names == [r["family"] for r in comparison["families"]]
    assert [q / 4 for q in quarters] == [r["delta"] for r in comparison["families"]]
    state = plan["bootstrap"]["seed"] & 0xffffffff
    def random():
        global state
        state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) & 0xffffffff
        value = ((state ^ (state >> 15)) * (1 | state)) & 0xffffffff
        value = (value ^ ((value + ((value ^ (value >> 7)) * (61 | value))) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff
        return (value ^ (value >> 14)) / 4294967296
    samples = [sum(quarters[math.floor(random() * len(quarters))] for _ in quarters) for _ in range(plan["bootstrap"]["samples"])]
    samples.sort()
    tail = (1 - plan["gate"]["confidence"]) / (2 * len(plan["comparisons"]))
    interval = [samples[math.floor(tail * len(samples))] / 432,
                samples[min(len(samples) - 1, math.floor((1 - tail) * len(samples)))] / 432]
    mean = sum(quarters) / 432
    gate = {"enoughFamilies": len(names) >= plan["gate"]["minFamilies"],
            "enoughChangedFamilies": sum(changed.values()) >= plan["gate"]["minChangedFamilies"],
            "minimumGain": mean >= plan["gate"]["minGain"], "positiveAdjustedInterval": interval[0] > 0}
    assert mean == comparison["mean"] and interval == comparison["interval"]
    assert gate == comparison["gate"] and all(gate.values()) == comparison["passed"]
    assert gains == comparison["gained"] and losses == comparison["lost"]
    comparisons.append({"id": comparison["id"], "gainPoints": 100 * mean,
                        "adjustedIntervalPoints": [100 * x for x in interval], "gains": gains, "losses": losses,
                        "changedFamilies": sum(changed.values()), "gate": gate, "passed": all(gate.values())})

benchmark = read("benchmark/benchmark.json")
assert benchmark["exactOutcomeParity"]
summary = {"atUtc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "qualityPassed": True,
           "allOriginalCompleteParentControlsExact": same_parents, "sourceFilesVerified": len(seal["sources"]),
           "everyScoreReconstructedFromAuthoritativeWinner": True, "jointPreviewFeatureChecks": preview_checks,
           "comparisons": comparisons, "counts": {k: dict(v) for k, v in counts.items()},
           "allRegisteredScreenGatesPassed": all(c["passed"] for c in comparisons),
           "exposedDevelopmentCases": 216, "reusedFamilies": 108, "newIndependentStrengthFamilies": 0,
           "noConfirmationBankAllocatedOrOpened": True, "defaultChanged": False, "deploymentPerformed": False}
with (p / "independent-verification.json").open("x") as f:
    json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(summary))

    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()

    keys.add(row["key"])
    team = cases[row["caseId"]]["input"]["candidateTeam"]
    assert data["ranked"]["candidateTeam"] == team
    assert data["freeTeams"] == []
    assert data["protectTeams"] == ([team] if row["arm"] == "protect-entrant" else [])
    assert data["jointTeams"] == ([team] if row["arm"] == "joint-entrant" else [])
assert len(keys) == len(prepared["rows"]) == 648

for file in (p / "benchmark/cache/battles").glob("*.json"):
